# Creative Moth

> Creative Moth is an online marketplace for downloadable digital designs and creative files from independent designers.

Creative Moth helps buyers discover digital products and gives independent designers reviewed storefronts for selling downloadable creative work.

## Main marketplace

- Homepage: https://creativemoth.com/
- Browse digital designs: https://creativemoth.com/browse
- Sitemap: https://creativemoth.com/sitemap.xml
- About Creative Moth: https://creativemoth.com/about

## Marketplace content

Public marketplace content includes:

- SVG files
- PNG and sublimation designs
- seamless patterns and digital papers
- clipart and lineart
- fonts
- Procreate brushes and stamps
- templates
- mockups
- printables
- embroidery and laser files
- digital services
- custom designs
- designer collaborations
- other downloadable creative files

Categories are available under:

https://creativemoth.com/category/

Individual products are available under:

https://creativemoth.com/product/

Independent designer storefronts are available under:

https://creativemoth.com/store/

Custom design listings are available under:

https://creativemoth.com/custom-designs

## Battle of the Designers

Creative Moth hosts public designer competitions where marketplace users can follow and vote in head-to-head designer matchups.

- Battle hub: https://creativemoth.com/battle-of-the-designers
- Grand Opening Battle: https://creativemoth.com/battle-of-the-designers/grand-opening

## Marketplace information

- Buyer FAQ: https://creativemoth.com/buyer-faq
- Seller FAQ: https://creativemoth.com/seller-faq
- Licensing help: https://creativemoth.com/licensing-help
- Sell on Creative Moth: https://creativemoth.com/sell
- Contact: https://creativemoth.com/contact
- Terms: https://creativemoth.com/terms
- Privacy: https://creativemoth.com/privacy

## Product and creator information

Product pages may include:

- product title and description
- digital file type
- product category
- pricing
- licensing information
- POD permissions
- AI-use disclosure
- preview images
- creator/store information
- related products

Storefront pages may include:

- designer or shop name
- shop description
- products
- custom services
- collaborations
- reviews
- public social and website links

## Crawling

Public marketplace, product, category, storefront, informational, and competition pages are intended for public discovery.

Private account, seller-management, checkout, download, dashboard, and administrative areas are not public discovery pages.

Crawler directives are published at:

https://creativemoth.com/robots.txt

Canonical public URLs and discoverable marketplace pages are published in:

https://creativemoth.com/sitemap.xml
